explanation.what: scan returns before matching any rule against a line longer than 10,000 characters, and records nothing for it.
explanation.why: This change added the length cut to bound regular expression time, and made the skipped line read as clean.
explanation.fix: Fail closed: report a line the scan will not match as a hit of its own, or match it with an engine whose time is linear in the line.

arguments.failureScenario: A pull request adds the line it.only("works", () => { followed by 10,000 spaces and a closing comment. The line is longer than maxLineLength, scan returns before matching it, and the focused-test rule reports nothing, so the pull request merges with the rest of that suite skipped; the base flagged the line.
